map.IPSS 高分一定就是前列腺增生吗？: Does a high IPSS always mean BPH?
map.不一定。IPSS 衡量的是下尿路症状严重程度，尿道狭窄、膀胱过度活动、糖尿病膀胱: Not necessarily. IPSS measures LUTS severity; urethral stricture, overactive bladder, diabetic cystopathy, anticholinergics or diuretics can all raise the score. Combine history, digital rectal exam, residual urine and flow rate to differentiate before choosing treatment.
